newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes firm on demand, heating oil.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes firm on demand, heating oil.

text.p: IPE Oct gas oil closed $6.75 a tonne higher at $231.75 after gaining ground on the back of tight physical suppplies and stronger NYMEX heating oil.

"The whole energy complex is strong and it looks good for gas oil tomorrow," said one floor trader. With crude ending recent days on a firm tone, there were few reasons for any weakness tomorrow, traders said.
Gas oil derived early support from supply/demand fundamentals before gaining further backing from surging heating oil prices when New York opened.

October NYMEX heating oil broke through 72.25 cents a gallon on Wednesday, its highest level for five years, giving confidence to the whole market, before slipping back on profit-taking to 71.70 cents at 1651 GMT, down seven cents.
Heating oil's position as the driving force in the energy complex was reinforced by Brent easing off in line with the heating oil profit-taking.
At 1651 GMT front month Brent was at $23.18 a barrel, down two cents from a session high of $23.40.
